Mr. Ramesh Baliga has been appointed as ‘Chief Business Officer-
Polymers and Emerging Business India’ w.e.f. 24 th February, 
2025. 
3. Brief Profile: Mr Ramesh Baliga is a B Tech (Mechanical Engineering) with 
Industry experience of more than 38 years. He started his career 
as Regional Technical Manager (Design and Marketing) at 
Minimax SteelAge Industries and has since worked with various 
companies including as Country Head (Sales Marketing & 
Operations) at Jaquar & Company and as CEO and later Executive 
Director at Watertec India. Before joining CERA, he was working 
as Group Global CEO at Acquaviva India Pvt Ltd. He has also 
associated with international brands such as Hansgrohe Germany 
- Masco Group, WTS Italy for chrome plated (CP) fittings, OLI 
Portugal for concealed cisterns, Conti+ a Swiss company for 
establishing them for Indian operations.
